name: Shiina Sayane
source:
Heiress to the Millenium Heavy Industries, an organization which vests its interests in research and development. Cold and haughty, she looks down on her peers and considers them "uninteresting".

Heads the Shiina faction which opposes the power position of the student council headed by Narumi.
